review_scope: Read existing Docker Engine snapshot and previous sealed summaries only; no new daemon scan/build/pull/prune/installation; only this derived review JSON added.

docker_cli_28_3_2_accounting.formula: LayersSize + sum(BuildCache.Size where Shared == false). Docker CLI28.3.2 summary already excludes shared cache from BuilderSize. Adding all cache record sizes would double count image-shared cache.
docker_cli_28_3_2_accounting.qualification: Daemon storage accounting, not host allocated physical blocks, not exact per-project storage. 2,413,293,031 is CURRENT private-cache total, not task net growth.

project_classification.method: De-duplicate immutable Engine image IDs, union recognized project tags with Compose project/service container references, explicitly include both Postgres digests. Tags are provenance clues; references may span historical and current project runtimes.
limits: Size minus SharedSize is globally exclusive image-content lower bound; project-internal shared layers are omitted.
Sum Size across unique IDs is only a conservative logical content upper bound for KNOWN images. SharedSize values must not be summed or divided heuristically.

Six historical referenced IDs are absent from this snapshot image metadata; size/physical retention remain unavailable, not zero. Therefore the complete project12GiB condition is not proven by the visible subset.
SharedSize unknown/-1 must stay unknown; no such field should be silently clamped to zero.
Stopped container references remain references. Images Active in system-df means Containers>0, not currently running services; InUse=false/Reclaimable do not grant cleanup authority.
RootFS DiffID/ChainID identity can help explain sharing but does not itself yield exact host physical byte sizes.

growth_comparison.qualification: Current rounded-baseline global proxy is about2.900GiB, but not exact project delta. It does not erase the previously observed3.63GB proxy warning or prove why snapshot sizes changed. Missing earlier exact ownership/private-cache state prevents reconstructing exact task-attributed historical peak.

allowed_continuation_under_current_decis.bounded_artifact_downloads: Only declared evidence limits with host free-space headroom rechecked.
allowed_continuation_under_current_decis.user_grype_cleanup_scope: Previous explicit authorization covered only that already-deleted aborted Grype DB, not images, historical caches, volumes or other projects.

before_any_future_local_expansion: Retain current raw snapshot privately; publish only project-scoped derived totals and limitations.
Resolve or explicitly bound unavailable historical image metadata and attribute current project images/cache.
Use the same cumulative goal/WP accounting; do not reset growth baseline by changing package, tag, task name or agent.
Give a bounded estimate for download/unpack/build peak plus retained old layers; check host and Docker storage headroom against that estimate and project absolute/growth limits.

If safe bounds cannot be proven within existing thresholds, continue cloud CI and unaffected read-only/source work; any capacity increase, relocation or destructive cleanup requires its applicable separate user decision.
